units.source_text: 阿泷从旅馆澡塘的后门咚咚咚地跑下石阶，

en.t: Otaki came clattering down the stone steps from the back door of the inn bathhouse,

units.source_text: 忽然听到有人说，“在河里太冷啦”，

en.t: when she suddenly heard someone say, "It is too cold in the river,"

units.source_text: 她就扑通一声跳进了澡塘。

en.t: and with a splash she jumped into the bath.

units.source_text: 女人们一边躲闪飞溅过来的水花，一边招呼说：

en.t: The women dodged the water splashing toward them as they called out:
